title: 第1352章 二号薇丝帕第1351章 依旧不是本体
content_zh:
这一次，没有自爆。
她的手掌触碰到金属表面的瞬间，金属表面便自动浮现出了无数道细密的金色符文。
那些符文的结构与楚夏之前看到的一模一样，古老而玄奥，散发着一种超越法则的本源之力。符文在金属表面不断流转组合，迅速凝聚成了那枚钥匙形状的图案。
整个过程只用了不到一个呼吸的时间，比刚才自爆解锁的速度还要快上几分。
金属立方体再次发出那个空灵而机械的声音：“密码正确，复苏程序启动，请稍等。”
片刻后，金属立方体的表面再次出现了一个门洞。
门洞无声无息地向外扩展，金属如同液态般向两侧流淌，露出了内部漆黑的空间。
一个曼妙的身影从门洞中缓缓走了出来。
她穿着一身毛茸茸的大衣，大衣的材质看起来极其柔软蓬松，呈现出一种温暖的米白色，衣领高高竖起，将她的半张脸都埋在了毛茸茸的领口中。
大衣的下摆一直垂到小腿，将她整个身体都裹得严严实实，看起来就像是一只刚从冬眠中醒来的毛绒动物。
她的五官和一号薇丝帕一模一样，精致而完美的面庞，白皙如凝脂的肌肤，漆黑如深渊的眼眸。
但她的气质却和一号截然不同，一号薇丝帕是威严、从容、高贵，而她则是慵懒、迷糊、没睡醒。
她打了个大大的哈欠，用手背揉了揉眼角，然后用一种极其慵懒的声调说道：“干嘛第二个就叫醒我，应该把我留到最后一个唤醒，这样我还可以多睡一会。”
一号薇丝帕双手抱胸，冷眼看着二号，语气中带着一丝不耐烦：“别偷懒了，眼下的形势你也十分清楚，机会就这一次，错过了还不知道要等到何年何月。我已经被困得不耐烦了，再多待一天都是煎熬。”
二号薇丝帕伸了个懒腰，毛茸茸的大衣随着她的动作微微敞开，露出了大衣里面的穿着——竟然也是一套睡衣，丝绸质地，淡粉色，上面印着一个个可爱的小绵羊图案。
她一边活动着僵硬的脖颈，一边慢悠悠地说道：“我倒是无所谓，待在哪里不是待，现在世道又不太平，何苦出去自寻烦恼呢，虚妄大陆虽然无聊了点，但好歹安全，肯塔乌那个老东西再厉害也找不到这里来。”
一号的声音骤然冷了几分，语气中带上了一丝不容置疑的命令感：“少啰嗦，少数服从多数，你没得选，你以为我喜欢跟你商量吗？按照规则，我可以强行融合你，只是我不愿意那么做罢了。”
二号撇了撇嘴，依旧是那副懒洋洋的表情，但语气中多少带上了一丝妥协的味道：“行吧行吧，真是拗不过你们几个……不过话说回来，你们真的打算跟那家伙合作？他可不是什么善类，小心被反咬一口。”
那家伙？
楚夏站在一旁，听到这句话时眉头不由自主地皱了起来。

二号薇丝帕说的“那家伙”是谁？该不会是说他吧？但听她的语气，似乎不像是在说一个站在她面前的人，而是在说某个不在场的第三方。
“一个初生牛犊而已，何足挂齿。”
一号语气从容不迫：“任他天资再如何卓绝，终究也只是被我们利用的工具罢了。”
楚夏的表情没什么变化，但心中却微微一沉。
果然，薇丝帕的合作对象不只有他一个人。
但会是谁呢？
能被维斯帕女王评价为天资卓绝，那显然不是等闲之辈，难道是万界位面的某个顶级天才强者？
楚夏本想开口询问，但一号薇丝帕已经抬起右手，修长的玉指再次在空中划出一道空间缝隙。
“走，下一个。”
一号薇丝帕头也不回地踏入了空间缝隙，黑色的短裙摆在她身后轻轻摇曳。
二号薇丝帕站在原地，看着一号消失在空间缝隙中，又打了个哈欠，然后慢悠悠地走到楚夏身旁，上下打量了他一眼。
她站得离楚夏很近，近到楚夏能闻到她身上那股若有若无的甜香，甜丝丝软绵绵的，和一号那种清冷到让人窒息的气场截然不同。
“那家伙穿的衣服，还有没有？给我也来一套。”
二号指了指一号消失的方向，语气随意而自然，仿佛在跟一个相熟多年的老友聊天。
content_en:
This time, there was no self-destruction.
The moment her palm touched the metal surface, countless fine golden runes automatically appeared on the metal surface.
The structure of those runes was exactly the same as what Chu Xia had seen before. It was ancient and mysterious, exuding an original power that transcended laws. The runes continued to flow and combine on the metal surface, quickly condensing into the key-shaped pattern.
The whole process took less than a breath, which was a few minutes faster than the speed of self-destruction and unlocking just now.
The metal cube once again made that ethereal and mechanical voice: "The password is correct, the recovery procedure is started, please wait."
After a moment, a doorway appeared again on the surface of the metal cube.
The doorway silently expanded outwards, and the metal flowed to both sides like a liquid, revealing the dark space inside.
A graceful figure slowly walked out of the doorway.
She was wearing a furry coat. The material of the coat looked extremely soft and fluffy, showing a warm off-white color. The collar was raised high, burying half of her face in the furry collar.
The hem of the coat hung down to her calves, wrapping her entire body tightly, making her look like a stuffed animal that had just woken up from hibernation.
Her facial features were exactly the same as Vesper No. 1, with a delicate and perfect face, skin as white as cream, and eyes as dark as the abyss.
But her temperament is completely different from No. 1. No. 1 Vesper is majestic, calm, and noble, while she is lazy, confused, and not awake.
She yawned widely, rubbed the corners of her eyes with the back of her hand, and then said in an extremely lazy tone: "Why are you the second one to wake me up? You should leave me to be the last one to wake up, so that I can sleep a little longer."
Vesper No. 1 crossed her arms and looked at No. 2 coldly, with a hint of impatience in her tone: "Don't be lazy. You are also very clear about the current situation. This opportunity is only once. If you miss it, you don't know how long it will take to wait. I am already trapped and impatient. Staying for one more day will be torture."
Vesper No. 2 stretched out, and her furry coat opened slightly as she moved, revealing what she was wearing under the coat - it turned out to be a set of pajamas, made of silk, light pink, with cute little sheep patterns printed on it.
While moving her stiff neck, she said slowly: "It doesn't matter to me. It doesn't matter where I stay. The world is not peaceful now, so why go out and look for trouble. Although the False Continent is a bit boring, it is safe at least. No matter how powerful the old guy Kentau is, he can't find it here."
Number 1's voice suddenly became colder, and there was an undoubted sense of command in his tone: "Stop being verbose, the minority obeys the majority, you have no choice. Do you think I like to discuss it with you? According to the rules, I can forcibly fuse you, but I don't want to do that."
No. 2 curled his lips, still with the same lazy expression, but there was a hint of compromise in his tone: "Okay, okay, I really can't beat you guys... But having said that, do you really plan to cooperate with that guy? He is not a kind person, be careful of getting bitten back."
That guy?
Chu Xia stood aside and frowned involuntarily when she heard this sentence.
Who is "that guy" Vesper Two is talking about? Could it be that he was talking about him? But listening to her tone, it didn't seem like she was talking about a person standing in front of her, but a third party who was not present.
"It's just a newborn calf, nothing worth mentioning."
Number One's tone was calm and unhurried: "No matter how talented he is, in the end he is just a tool to be used by us."
Chu Xia's expression did not change, but her heart sank slightly.
Sure enough, he wasn't the only one Vesper was working with.
But who could it be?
Being judged to be extremely talented by Queen Vespa is obviously not something to be taken lightly.Could it be that this person is some top genius in the world?
Chu Xia wanted to ask, but Vesper No. 1 had already raised her right hand, and her long jade fingers once again drew a gap in space in the air.
"Let's go, next one."
Vespa No. 1 stepped into the gap in space without looking back, her black short skirt swaying gently behind her.
Vesper No. 2 stood there, watching No. 1 disappear into the gap in space, yawned again, then walked slowly to Chu Xia and looked him up and down.
She stood very close to Chu Xia, so close that Chu Xia could smell the vague sweet fragrance on her body, which was sweet and soft, completely different from No. 1's cold and suffocating aura.
"Do you still have the clothes that guy is wearing? Give me a set too."
No. 2 pointed in the direction where No. 1 disappeared, and his tone was casual and natural, as if he was chatting with an old friend he had known for many years.
